title: ATICO _ Sofa one and two seats
pageTitle: ATICO _ Sofa one and two seats
description: Atico Sofas is a collection of furniture that seamlessly blends functionality and aesthetics in its design. Its structure consists of a base that combines two wooden rings and tubes coated with electrostatic paint, serving both as support and legs.

With two options available, these sofas can fit small and large spaces. You can choose between two or three seats. They strike a balance between classic and modern style; the concept behind is contrast, achieved by combining wood and steel.
The upholstery of this chair is a careful choice, using a green-toned fabric with a robust yet comfortable texture
